settings.title: Mol3D Viewer Settings
settings.blockWidthDesc: Default width of molecule cards in notes, e.g. 100% or 400px
settings.blockHeightDesc: Default height of molecule cards in notes, e.g. 400px
settings.borderWidthDesc: Border width of molecule cards, e.g. 1px; set 0 to hide
settings.transparentDesc: When enabled, the background color setting is ignored
settings.backgroundColorDesc: Canvas background color when transparency is disabled

rows.width: Card width, e.g. width: 400px or width: 80%
rows.title: Show a title bar above the canvas
rows.style: Mol* representation: ball-and-stick / spacefill / line / cartoon / gaussian-surface
rows.bg: Background color; bg: transparent for transparency
rows.topology: Pair a topology file for trajectory formats (dcd/xtc/trr/nc/lammpstrj), e.g. topology: [[system.psf]]
rows.model: Pair a structure file as trajectory topology, e.g. model: [[system.pdb]]
rows.cell: Unit cell mode: unit (default) / supercell (3x3x3) / contacts (crystal contacts, core CIF only)

settings.occlusionDesc: SSAO: deeper shading in crevices and contacts
settings.dofDesc: Blur out-of-focus regions (may slow down large systems)
settings.transparencyModeDesc: WBOIT default, DPOIT more accurate, Blended most compatible
settings.pixelScaleDesc: Render resolution multiplier, sharper but slower (0.5-2)

errors.libNotLoaded: Mol* library not loaded. Make sure molstar.js exists in the plugin folder
errors.trajectoryNeedsTopology: Trajectory file requires a topology keyword, e.g. topology: [[system.psf]]
errors.topologyNeedsTrajectory: Topology file: pair it with a trajectory file, e.g. a dcd/xtc code block with topology: [[this file]]
